sentences.en: A waterfall of sweat began to pour down my face.
sentences.zh: 我脸上开始流下汗水如瀑布般倾泻。

sentences.en: She smoothly and elegantly poured the water into the glass.
sentences.zh: 她熟练而优雅地把水倒进了玻璃杯里。

sentences.en: Don't pour hot water into the glass or it will crack.
sentences.zh: 别往杯子里倒热水，否则会裂开的。

senses.zh: 灌，倒；倾泻；（雨）倾盆而下；涌进，涌出；斟（饮料）；纷至沓来
